verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents an onboarding path: try the API in the browser playground, then generate API keys in the Console. It also ships official SDKs in seven languages with idiomatic interfaces, which supports the 'my language' part of the story. The pack does not show a quickstart page with runnable first-call snippets, and nothing evidences the 'minutes to first call' claim. Missing for 10: a documented quickstart guide with runnable per-language first-call code, evidence of time-to-first-successful-call, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from zero to a first successful API call in minutes, with runnable code in my language

citations.quote: In the Console, you can use playground (platform.claude.com/playground) to try out the API in the browser and then generate API keys on the API keys page

Client SDKs: General-purpose Messages API clients for Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby. Each SDK provides idiomatic interfaces, type safety, and built-in support for streaming, retries, and error handling
